Current Behavioral Wellness Gaps

The Problem We're Solving

Educational institutions and independent mentors want to support students, but broken escalation chains and siloed tools create systemic risks.

Institutional Challenge

Fragmented Support

Mental and behavioral wellness programs may exist inside institutions but are not always implemented consistently or connected to actionable care.

Systemic Impact:

Coordinators and faculty lack unified visibility, causing at-risk students to slip through cracks.

The WTF Solution:

WTF establishes a standardized, campus-wide operating system with continuous tracking and accountability.

Escalation Bottleneck

Limited Professional Access

Teachers and life coaches may identify concerns but need qualified professionals when situations go beyond their scope.

Systemic Impact:

Unlicensed coaches face liability and anxiety when complex clinical needs arise without supervision.

The WTF Solution:

WTF connects coaches directly to qualified, credentialed in-house providers for immediate escalation and sign-off.

Student Experience

Unstructured Student Journey

Students need a clear journey from assessment to learning, monitoring, and professional intervention when appropriate.

Systemic Impact:

Random wellness seminars fail to produce sustained behavioral changes or measurable improvement.

The WTF Solution:

A progressive 16-week modular curriculum with closed-loop assessments and personalized pathways.

Systemic Disconnect

Disconnected Healthcare Workflow

Assessment, Telehealth, EHR, AI documentation, and billing often exist as completely disconnected systems.

Systemic Impact:

Clinicians waste hours on manual re-entry while billing reconciliation and clinical compliance suffer.

The WTF Solution:

WTF unifies AI medical scribing, EHR documentation, Telehealth, and RCM into one frictionless platform.

Status QuoFragmented Support & Siloed ToolsUncoordinated coaches, lost assessments, delayed clinical intervention

Clinical Workflow Synergy

Assessment & Professional Review

How WTF combines intelligent automated medical scribing with rigorous, human-in-the-loop clinical governance.

Core Clinical Principle

AI assists the workflow. Qualified professionals make the final clinical decision.

No automated diagnosis. No unreviewed prescription. AI performs documentation synthesis; licensed human therapists and physicians retain 100% diagnostic and clinical authority.

Machine Efficiency

AI-Assisted Assessment

QuestionnaireAI Medical ScribeStructured Output

Seamless Care Escalation

When More Support Is Needed

Life coaching and curriculum learning are transformative, but clinical conditions demand licensed medical and psychological professionals. WTF bridges this divide safely.

Psychotherapy Track

Therapy Sessions

When assessments or coach reviews reveal moderate symptoms requiring clinical care, the student is scheduled for 1-on-1 psychotherapy with an in-house licensed clinician (LCSW, LMFT, LPC).

Clinical Focus:

Evidence-based cognitive and behavioral psychotherapeutic care plans.

Operates independently of coaching sessions with full clinical privilege separation.
Psychiatric Oversight

Medical Consultation

For complex behavioral situations requiring psychiatric diagnostic clarity, our board-certified psychiatrists evaluate medical necessity and coordinate physician-directed care.

Clinical Focus:

Comprehensive diagnostic interviews and medication evaluation when indicated.

Direct physician sign-off adhering strictly to state medical board requirements.
Clinical Matching

Intelligent Provider Assignment

WTF automatically matches students to credentialed clinicians based on state licensure, clinical specialty (e.g., student burnout, anxiety, sports wellness), and immediate calendar availability.

Clinical Focus:

Warm handoffs that preserve assessment context so students never repeat their story.

Cross-state licensure verification and NPI registry synchronization.
HIPAA-Compliant Video

Integrated Telehealth

Consultations occur securely inside the browser via our WebRTC encrypted suite. No third-party links or downloads needed by students, faculty, or clinicians.

Clinical Focus:

One-click joining, integrated in-session notes, and active crisis safety beacons.

End-to-end AES-256 encryption with zero video data recording on local devices.
Clinical Continuity

EHR Documentation & RCM

Session progress notes, standardized clinical scales, and treatment goals sync to the EHR, feeding directly into billing workflows and insurance claims.

Clinical Focus:

Standardized SOAP note generation and automated ANSI X12 837 claim processing.

Audit-ready medical records compliant with 45 CFR § 164 and payer guidelines.

Safety & Crisis Protocol

Crisis Support & Emergency Redirection

WTF University is engineered with strict patient safety boundaries. While the platform provides structured proactive wellness, acute emergencies trigger immediate handoff to certified crisis lifelines.

Step 1

Crisis Identified

Continuous AI keyword scanning, assessment red flags, or user-triggered urgent distress beacon.

Step 2

WTF Safety Workflow

Normal workflow pauses immediately. Safety screen modal deploys with reassuring de-escalation guidance.

Step 3

External Crisis Resource

Instant 1-tap connection to 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, Crisis Text Line, or local emergency 911 dispatch.

Emergency Protocol (USA)

Immediate External Help Lines • Confidential & Free 24/7

WTF is NOT an emergency dispatch service

If you, a student, or a colleague are experiencing suicidal ideation, self-harm impulses, severe psychosis, or acute medical distress, please utilize these dedicated national resources immediately:

988 Suicide & Crisis LifelineCall or text 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Free, confidential support from trained crisis counselors.Call 988 Lifeline
Crisis Text LineText HOME to 741741 to connect with a volunteer crisis counselor via SMS anytime.Text HOME to 741741
Emergency Medical ServicesFor immediate physical danger, medical crises, or accidents, contact 911 or go to your nearest emergency department.Call 911 Emergency
Campus coordinators & counselors receive asynchronous safety event alerts
Full compliance with federal student health and crisis intervention safety standards

Clinical Core

Electronic Health Record (EHR)

Standard: HL7 FHIR v4 / SMART on FHIR

Bi-directional synchronization of patient clinical charts, validated SOAP notes, diagnostic codes, and treatment plans via HL7 FHIR APIs.

Eliminates dual-charting for providers and maintains longitudinal clinical histories compliant with 45 CFR § 164.

Billing & Claims

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

Standard: ANSI X12 837 / 835 EDI

Automated claim generation, real-time insurance eligibility checks, batch 837P filing, and electronic remittance processing (835).

Drastically reduces claim denial rates for telehealth psychotherapy and psychiatric necessity consultations.

Documentation Intelligence

AI Medical Scribe Engine

Standard: HIPAA BAA & Zero-Retention AI Enclave

Proprietary clinical NLP converts assessment questionnaires and video transcripts into formatted clinical summaries using standardized diagnostic templates.

Reduces clinician documentation burden by 70% while keeping licensed providers firmly in the sign-off seat.

Virtual Care

Integrated WebRTC Telehealth

Standard: WebSockets / WebRTC / AES-256 GCM

Browser-based encrypted HD video sessions with zero software downloads required for students, faculty, coaches, and clinicians.

High-reliability, low-latency video care with integrated live session notes, chat, and an instant emergency crisis beacon.

Engagement & Adherence

Automated SMS & Multichannel Reminders

Standard: 10DLC Verified / TCPA Compliant

Intelligent notification pipeline dispatching weekly module prompts, appointment reminders, and coach check-in nudges via SMS and email.

Maintains 92%+ weekly student curriculum retention through personalized, gentle, and timely reminders.

Financial Infrastructure

Enterprise & Copay Payment Gateway

PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant payment processor supporting institutional bulk licensing, HSA/FSA card payments, and direct patient copays.

Clear Answers About WTF University

Everything you need to know about our technology, coaching scopes, clinical governance, and institutional partnership workflows.

WTF University is a technology-enabled mental and behavioral wellness ecosystem that connects institutions, students/patients, life coaches, and qualified providers/therapists. It provides structured behavioral assessments, guided 16-week learning, professional clinical supervision, integrated telehealth, and healthcare billing workflows in a unified platform.

Topic: General

The WTF Certified Life Coach pathway trains non-clinical mentors in our behavioral wellness curriculum and strict scope boundaries. Coaches guide students through weekly goal-setting, reflection, and habit restructuring. Crucially, coaches operate under the supervision of WTF licensed clinicians and utilize a single-click escalation tool whenever clinical concerns arise.

Topic: Coaches

Licensed providers are involved at mandatory clinical milestones: validating the initial baseline assessment, reviewing 4-week milestone progress, and conducting clinical therapy or medical necessity consultations whenever a student flags moderate-to-severe distress. Life coaches never practice clinical therapy—all clinical determinations remain exclusively with licensed professionals.

Clinical Scope & Healthcare Safeguards

WTF University is a technology-enabled behavioral wellness and care-coordination SaaS platform. WTF University is not an acute emergency dispatch service. The platform provides structured self-guided learning, non-clinical behavioral life coaching, and coordinated access to independent licensed healthcare providers. Life coaches provide educational and habit mentorship within defined non-clinical scopes and do not provide medical diagnosis, psychotherapy, or psychiatric treatment.

AI features on WTF University function strictly as assistive administrative documentation tools and do not make autonomous clinical judgments. Final clinical determinations, therapy prescriptions, and medical evaluations are made exclusively by licensed human healthcare professionals.
